expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with additional message types, clearer and more robust encoding and decoding, improved validation and error reporting, and compatibility-focused round-trip tests to support future protocol evolution.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope.
